cmd-1791207577055.value:
{"command":"cat > dev/lab/targets.yml <<'EOF'
# Deliberately outdated servers for the first OpenVAS scan. They join the
# appliance stack's network and publish no host ports, so nothing outside
# Docker can reach them.
#
#   docker compose -f dev/lab/targets.yml up -d
#   docker compose -f dev/lab/targets.yml down
name: scanner-lab

services:
  httpd:
    image: httpd:2.4.49
    # CVE-2021-41773 is only reachable with "Require all granted" on the
    # filesystem root, so the first occurrence in httpd.conf is flipped.
    command: ["sh", "-c", "sed -i '0,/Require all denied/s//Require all granted/' /usr/local/apache2/conf/httpd.conf && exec httpd-foreground"]
  tomcat:
    image: tomcat:9.0.30
    # Some builds of this image ship the default webapps in webapps.dist.
    command: ["sh", "-c", "[ -d webapps.dist ] && cp -rn webapps.dist/. webapps/; exec catalina.sh run"]
  redis:
    image: redis:5.0.7
  nginx:
    image: nginx:1.16.1

networks:
  default:
    name: scanner-appliance_default
    external: true
EOF

import socket, time
def ask(cmd, limit=600, wait=60):
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    s.settimeout(wait)
    s.connect("/run/ospd/ospd.sock")
    s.sendall(cmd.encode())
    t0 = time.time()
    buf = b""
    total = 0
    try:
        while True:
            chunk = s.recv(65536)
            if not chunk:
                break
            total += len(chunk)
            if len(buf) < limit:
                buf += chunk
    except socket.timeout:
        pass
    s.close()
    return buf[:limit].decode(errors="replace"), total, time.time() - t0
